run_pybullet_gui_simulation: run a pybullet GUI simulation that loads a transparent sphere and a plane URDF
create_debug_sliders: create user debug sliders to control red, green, blue, and alpha color channels interactively
change_visual_shape_rgba: change the visual shape RGBA color of a loaded URDF object using changeVisualShape
read_debug_parameter_values: read user debug parameter slider values in a loop to get real-time color input
render_camera_image_segmentation: render a camera image with segmentation mask flags using the Bullet hardware OpenGL renderer
